title: How a Suspected Chinese Spy Gained Access to Nvidia Chips
summary: A woman whom U.S. intelligence identified as a Chinese spy had ties to Nvidia’s chief executive, Jensen Huang, dating to at least 2023. Ana Swanson, our reporter on trade and economics, explains what new photos show.
